reviews.title: Ughhhh FIX UR APP
reviews.text:
I am so incredibly annoyed right now. WHO updated this app and thought this was a good idea?!

Previously, I could easily check things like the time, set a timer, or copy and paste a serial number from my camera while chatting with support. It worked fine. Now? If I even dare to glance away from the chat for two seconds to look up the info the agent is asking for, the chat disconnects. No warning. No grace period. Just booted out and forced to start over with a new agent.

You can claim this update is to help to "not waste time," but you are making us waste MORE time. I have now been disconnected more than three times simply because I needed to look at my router or check my billing email. You are punishing your customers for trying to give you accurate information.

To the developer who implemented this: you are making an already frustrating process completely unbearable. Revert this update or at least give us a 2-minute grace period to gather our stuff.

Do not hang up the phone until you get and read the email. They will lie and swindle you out of all they can. I noticed they were charging me for equipment fees on equipment I didn’t have for months. It took me 2 months to get them to reimburse me almost $400. They love taking advantage of the elderly as well. I have went to everyone I know over 50 and checked their bills. For the same services I am paying $40 I had a 89 year old grandmother paying $299.

reviews.title: Service Down
reviews.text:
I called yesterday to address a service issue at Friday at 3pm EDT. I was advised service was down. It is now 6pm EDT the following day and support services told me the service is still down in my area. I was told to look at the outage map, there is no evidence of my service being out and all my neighbors also use optimum and they all have internet. 

I am using a standard optimum modem. Since I work from Home, after being with optimum/suddenlink for over six years, I will have no choice but to cancel this service if things are not right by Monday. 

Internet outages that last more than 25 hours are not something I would expect from a top tier provider in the United States. This is unacceptable and has wasted a lot of my time already trying to understand the issue. It feels like I am being lied to because all my neighbors have service. I am outraged by this and hope to find a corporate team at optimum that will take the time to look into my case and find out what is truly happening. I hope this will be handled internally and swiftly please. Thank you.

reviews.title: Charged me twice for canceling
reviews.text: This service is dog but and I will never use it again. I payed too cancel my internet on march 2026 they then choose to send me an over draft fee of $232 in may saying it’s a cancellation fee. When I also got charged 100 and something days after I canceled in march. There service is slow as hell anyways and they love too call you days after you cancel asking why and if you would like any other service but fail too mention you have an existing balance. Never will use optimum again. If I could give 0 stars I would.

reviews.title: WORST COMPANY EVER !!
reviews.text:
I'm sorryI'm
I have never worked with a company As poorly run as this one, so where do I begin?
First off, I was Director of Operations for a major ISP, (cable company,) so in know what I’m talking about.

First, the customer service representatives are the worst, and many of them can hardly speak English, so that is problem  number one with customer service.

Problem number two, they downright lie to you. As an example, I was told I would get compensated for a problem with their system, and when the bill arrived there was no deduction.
I followed up with a phone call to Optimum and was told “You are incorrect, we would never have said that to you!” WHAT ARE YOU KIDDING?

Second, they will not give you a price for your service after 2-3 months. You have to constantly call and plead for another bill reduction reduction! Are you kidding me? How many companies do that?

“Oh I’m sorry sir, I know I’m your doctor, but in 2 months I have to charge you more money, and after that you’ll have to beg the nurse so I’ll charge less money!”

Silly example but it gets the point across.

Finally, if they have return your call, THEY NEVER DO!!

So now you are aware of the reasoning for my opinions and understand why this company rates last in 3 different opinion polls!

reviews.title: Worst customer service
reviews.text: Having intermittent slowness issues with my Internet, opened a case with support. Guess what I had to talk to multiple people and they all asked me do the same disconnect the power wait for 30 seconds and connect it back. But no luck even after multiple attempts. Finally they sent technician onsite, and this guy is even more worst. He came in swapped the power adapter and left without fixing the actual problem. And now the problem got more worse, paying for Gigabit plan, getting  only 50-60 Mbps download speed and 3-5 Mbps upload speed.

reviews.title: About to switch back to Verizon
reviews.text:
We switched to optimum almost two weeks ago . I have spent untold hours on chats and phone calls with your”experts” and still don’t have all of our services working. Currently we are without our home phone and , after two hours on the phone today, I was given the # of a BNL (?) service who was going to see our phone service was “ported over”. The number was answered by a homeowner in Long Island saying he’s gets these calls all the time and he is NOT connected with optimum!!

I have been treated so shabbily by your company I’m going to report it to a government agency.

reviews.title: *Displays WiFi pw in plaintext* - security nightmare. App has no features. I dont know why it exists
reviews.text:
TL;DR Stores your WiFi password in plaintext. Go to edit WiFi and see for yourself. The only thing the app is good for is payment, which most of us do automatically, and for those who don't, just pay on optimum dot net instead of downloading this security nightmare of an app    

It's offensive how badly arrogant people mess up the world when they are unwilling and unable to do better. The people and shareholders who own Altice should sell optimum to someone else who both wants to and is able to make the optimum company good again. I mean seriously - plaintext? With no security barrier? Jfc.

reviews.title: One star is generous.
reviews.text:
I received over 20 automated calls in one day about “service issues in the area,” yet the problems never actually got resolved. The constant disruptions — especially during work hours — were unacceptable.

Billing is worse. Promotional rates jump from around $49 to over $100 without proper notice. Retention promises one price on the phone, then the next bill shows something completely different. Long wait times, inconsistent information, and zero accountability.

Service is unreliable, billing is inconsistent, and customer service does not keep its word. I switched to Verizon.

reviews.title: Terrible app from a terrible company
reviews.text: I downloaded the app since i was told it had extensive troubleshooting for wifi issues which btw optimum has A LOT of. Each time it just gives up after the first diagnostics test of unplug it and plug it back in, (which anyone with a brain would do without the app) and says “please contact support” no i dont want to contact support thats the whole reason for even downloading the app. Id have to contact support every single day if that was the case and my patience is too low to have to deal with their overseas call centers.

reviews.title: Bring back the TV remote capabilities
reviews.text: Very upset that you took the tv remote capabilities off app without any warnings. It is very convenient to use phone as remote especially when looking on guide and wanting to watch program. THE APP IS ON MY PHONE.  Mostly everything is done on one’s phone these days and you took it off. It was also convenient to make sure all TVs are off in household when no one is watching. My cable bill is very high and every time I update app or watch TV something changes especially the price of my bill. You show the same movies over and over again. I have been a customer for over 30 years and the quality has declined. I have had enough. Now I know why everyone is dropping cable TV and going to streaming.

reviews.title: Internet
reviews.text: My internet keeps going down.  When I use the app it stated outage in your area but when I clicked in map it showed Lubbock and no outage in San Angelo.  I used the chat with live agent and they confirmed I had an outage and confirmed I would be notified when it was corrected.  I checked with neighbors and there was working so I unplugged modem and replugged it in and I have internet.   So upset that the agent confirmed an outage when if there was one it was 4 1/2 hours earlier.   I have had optimum out here to fix internet 3 times in the last month.  This is very frustrating especially since I can’t even rely on you to know when there is a true outage

reviews.title: Recording
reviews.text:
The recording is absolutely no help. It says there may be an outage in my area. Then it says to reboot it has been rebooted twice my television is still not working. I have been trying for the last 35 minutes to speak, no one is helping me. I need to speak with an agent now.

The recording also states that there is an outage in my area. That’s good that they say that, but when the recording asks what problem is that I’m having it says for me to go to my equipment and do this/that. I am disabled and cannot move the furniture to unplug it. The recording repeats again what is the issue. I need to speak to a live agent at this moment but the recording disconnects and I’m left with a bigger issue. 
  Optimum is useless!!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Im an Optimum customer for over 25 years started back when they were cablevision . I have never been more disappointed in a company before, I have been having Internet problems for the past two years. I’ve needed to replace my gateway three times. Third time was two months ago and so far I’ve had to to reset my gateway at least three times a week now I am currently away. I have no way to reset my gateway so therefore, my cameras are not working nor my switches outlets or anything else that runs on Wi-Fi.  I game so at 2:00am each morning the WiFi drops as if to save some energy attempts or something, not proven but there needs to be some explanation on why or how can one lose Internet connections at the same time daily,I also have been paying for 500 mbps and only receiving 1.9 to 3.2  totally unacceptable ! To be quite honest I’ve already scheduled FiOS to be installed by Verizon. Not to say that they would be any better cause I’m very skeptical , but we will see.

reviews.title: I Hate Optimum
reviews.text:
The agents are great and the service tech I just saw, but try to get an agent on the phone to talk to!! By the time you do, you are so frustrated. 
  Where I live the internet goes out a lot. I have never complained, but recently it was out for 2 weeks. I didn’t realize it was just my house for a few days, but I can prove by phone calls that I called may times starting at the 10 day ago mark. I just called for a credit. I get $15. For a 1/3 of a month when I pay $85 a month. I won’t even go through the whole run around BS that I dealt with. 
   Horrible company.

reviews.title: No No No
reviews.text: I have spent HOURS on the phone, on chats, on the internet trying to resolve my account. I have been disconnected countless times on the phone. Chats were ended without resolution to my situation. Every time I became disconnected I would have to restate my issues. The app has no information to easily access my account terms and conditions. Billing was not updated in real time. No issues with the actual internet service, it was fine. Charges increased unbeknownst to me. Good customer service once I was able to speak with someone entirely through my process other than them trying to offer “better” deals continuously. I would not recommend this service provider.

reviews.title: Shady Practice.
reviews.text: I switched from Verizon to Optimum thinking i was making a good decision. I was wrong. Outside of the frequent service outages. This app serves almost zero purpose. Its existence is solely created to block you from being a capable Internet Administrator of the household. You aren’t even allowed to manage any devices on your network. They only allow you to monitor how long devices have been online to “encourage healthy screen time” or whatever.. The many options that were once available once upon a time, are now inaccessible without them forcing you to speak to an Agent or probably locked behind paying them more money. Verizon allows for 10x more flexibility, rare service outages, faster download speeds for me by 120mbps, and I miss them dearly.
